title: Applications Engineer (Drives Specialist)
intro: A leading systems integrator in Telford is looking for an Applications Engineer with a drives specialism. You will sit between sales and engineering, turning customer specifications into well-scoped technical solutions, accurate costings and clear, persuasive proposals.
bullets: Configure technical solutions from end customer specifications
Estimate the resources and equipment each solution needs
Prepare high quality quotations, proposals and system topologies
Act as the technical link between the sales and engineering teams
Attend customer sites and meetings when required, in the UK and overseas
outro: This form takes around 15 minutes. Specific examples help us put the strongest candidates forward.
